ALWAYS FREE EGRESS. FAIL SECURE ELECTRIC STRIKES. OPTIONAL DOOR CONTROL BY SECURITY SYSTEM. ADA OPERATION: SEQUENCE BOTH LHR LEAVES FOR ADA EXITING ON INTERIOR ACTUATOR ACTIVATION.
